title: Aleph Souza’s Resume
text:
Data Science student and data analyst with experience in data visualization, automation, machine learning, and business intelligence.

Gmail | LinkedIn | GitHub



Data Science student at Brigham Young University–Idaho with experience using R, Python, SQL, Power BI, Power Automate, and SharePoint. Experienced in data analysis, reporting, process automation, data quality, and machine learning. Fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish.



Expected 2026 Brigham Young University–Idaho, Rexburg, Idaho

Bachelor of Science in Data Science
Minor in Statistics
Certificate in Machine Learning




January 2026 – Present Student Data and Research Analyst, Brigham Young University–Idaho

Developed automated workflows using Qualtrics, Power Automate, SharePoint, and Power BI.
Conducted data-quality audits in R and identified inaccuracies in institutional data.
Supported the development of an early-warning model used to identify students who may need additional assistance.
Created dashboards and reporting tools to support student-success programs.

July 2025 – January 2026 Data Quality Intern, FamilySearch

Audited multilingual datasets containing thousands of records.
Created Power BI dashboards to monitor project progress and data quality.
Supported the migration of data workflows from DataFlux to Databricks.
Developed Python workflows to improve data-processing and reporting tasks.







Designed a database and analytics system for tracking grocery prices across multiple stores.
Used MySQL, Python, Power BI, forecasting models, and automated data workflows.
Developed price comparisons, alerts, and purchasing insights for users.





Helped develop a weekly machine-learning model that categorized students into risk levels.
Combined academic, referral, mentoring, and enrollment information.
Created Power BI reports to communicate results to program leaders.





Developed a financial tracking system using Python, Google Sheets, OpenAI tools, and Power BI.
Organized and analyzed household financial information across multiple users.






Programming: Python, R, SQL
Data visualization: Power BI, ggplot2
Data tools: Excel, SharePoint, Power Automate, Qualtrics
Databases: MySQL, SQLite
Version control: Git and GitHub
Languages: Portuguese, English, Spanish




2024 - 2025 Teaching Assistant, Spreadsheet Analysis, Brigham Young University–Idaho

Assisted students with spreadsheet analysis, Excel, and VBA.
Created practice materials and supported student learning.

2023 - 2024 Report Manager, REDI

Managed data and reporting across 16 counties in Idaho.
Built Power BI reports and supported automated data collection.
